# CA Ashish Pandla — Senior Finance Leader & Chartered Accountant

> Executive portfolio and professional background of CA Ashish Pandla, Senior Finance Leader and Chartered Accountant with 8+ years of experience across FP&A, Financial Controlling, Ind-AS Reporting, and Strategic Business Partnering.

## Overview

Ashish Pandla is a qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI, 2018) with a strong track record across tech unicorn and multinational logistics environments (CARS24, cargo-partner). He specializes in Annual Operating Planning (AOP), rolling forecasts, unit economics, statutory audits, internal financial controls (IFC), and executive business partnering.

## Core Capabilities

- **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A):** Annual operating plans, rolling forecasts, unit economics, cohort analysis, variance tracking, and executive MIS dashboards.
- **Financial Controlling & Governance:** Ind-AS/IFRS compliance, statutory audits with Big-4 firms (EY, Grant Thornton), ICFR/IFC implementation, and tax governance.
- **Systems & Process Automation:** ERP migration and architecture, Chart of Accounts overhaul, automated reconciliation pipelines, Oracle, SAP, Power BI, and Advanced Excel.
- **Strategic Business Partnering:** Commercial pricing models, Capex/Opex evaluation, working capital management, and M&A integration.

## Key Career Highlights

- **Cost Optimization:** Delivered ₹50 lakhs in annual recurring savings across operational cost centers.
- **Profitability Turnaround:** Guided turnaround of ~75% profit centers to positive margins, improving productivity by 20% and doubling ROI from 1x to 2x.
- **Capital Transactions:** Executed capital structuring and financial operations for an ₹80 Crore ESOP share buyback at CARS24.
- **Audit Leadership:** Spearheaded statutory, internal, tax, and ICFR audits with zero adverse qualifications.
- **Global Expansion:** Structured international entities, overseas corporate banking setups, and end-to-end accounting for CARS24 Mega Refurbishment Labs (MRL).
- **Awards:** Employee of the Year 2021 & Detail-Oriented Awardee 2022 (CARS24); GEM Awards 2024 & 2025 (cargo-partner).

## Professional Experience

- **CARS24** (2021 – Present): Lead / Senior Manager — Financial Planning & Controlling
- **cargo-partner** (2018 – 2021): Assistant Manager — Finance & Accounts

## Education & Credentials

- **Chartered Accountant (CA):** The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), 2018 (Merit exemptions in SFM, AMA, and ISCA).
- **Master of Commerce (M.Com):** University of Rajasthan, 2016 (Financial Management & Strategic Cost Accounting).
- **Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com):** University of Rajasthan, 2014.

## Physical Address & Primary Office

- **Registered Location:** DLF Cyber City, Sector 24 / 25A, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India
